meta.description: A global AI closer for stores, clinics, and service brands.

hero.title: The closer that never sleeps.
hero.subtitle: VortexSales is the AI sales and booking agent for ambitious brands worldwide. It answers only from your knowledge, books the slot, and delivers the lead — in the visitor’s language.
hero.proof: Built for 40+ markets · Arabic & English native · Clinics, retail, services

logos.title: Designed for teams that sell across time zones

features.title: A sales floor. Inside the chat.
features.subtitle: Everything a closer needs — without hiring another night shift.

rag.title: Grounded answers
rag.body: The agent sells from your catalog, prices, and FAQs. If it does not know, it captures the lead instead of inventing a number.

booking.title: Booking in the thread
booking.body: Availability, confirmation, and reminders happen in the same conversation.

global.title: Born bilingual
global.body: English-first for the world, Arabic-first when the market demands it. True RTL.

widget.title: One-line install
widget.body: Drop a snippet on any site. The widget is fast, branded, and isolated.

inbox.title: Human when it matters
inbox.body: Hot leads land in a live inbox with intent scores and transcripts.

persona.title: Your voice, instantly
persona.body: Tune tone, language, and guardrails in the playground.

industries.title: One agent. Every high-intent counter.
industries.subtitle: From a Riyadh clinic to a Lisbon boutique — the same OS, local manners.

retail.title: Retail & D2C
retail.body: Guide size, stock, and bundles. Recover the cart in the chat.

clinics.title: Clinics & wellness
clinics.body: Triage FAQs, book consults, and collect the right intake.

services.title: Agencies & services
services.body: Qualify budget, propose a slot, and hand a brief to the team.

property.title: Property & hospitality
property.body: Tour times, unit facts, and follow-ups without a night receptionist.

one.title: Create the workspace
one.body: Name the brand, pick the market, set hours and timezone.

two.title: Feed the truth
two.body: Upload catalog, prices, and FAQs. The server stores it before any model is attached.

three.title: Drop the widget
three.body: Paste the snippet. Watch the playground, then open the doors.

pricing.title: Plans that travel with you.
pricing.subtitle: Start focused. Scale when the inbox gets loud.

howto.s1Title: ເມນູນີ້ແມ່ນແຜນທີ່ຂອງທ່ານ
howto.s1Body: ພາບລວມ, ກ່ອງຈົດໝາຍ, ລາຍການ, ການຈອງ. ກົດອັນໜຶ່ງ. ທ່ານທຳລາຍຫຍັງບໍ່ໄດ້.
howto.s2Title: ໃນກ່ອງຈົດໝາຍຄົນຂຽນຫາທ່ານ
howto.s2Body: ແຊັດຈາກເວັບມາທີ່ນີ້. WhatsApp ແລະ Instagram ຈະໃຊ້ກ່ອງດຽວກັນພາຍຫຼັງ.
howto.s3Title: ລາຍການມີລາຄາ. ຄວາມຮູ້ມີຂໍ້ເທັດຈິງ.
howto.s3Body: ໃສ່ສິ່ງທີ່ຂາຍກ່ອນ. ຜູ້ຊ່ວຍຫ້າມປະດິດຕົວເລກ.
howto.s4Title: Playground ແມ່ນການຊ້ອມທີ່ປອດໄພ
howto.s4Body: ທຳທ່າເປັນຜູ້ຢ້ຽມ. ເບິ່ງຄຳຕອບກ່ອນລູກຄ້າຈິງ.
howto.s5Title: AI ແລະເຊີບເວີມາສຸດທ້າຍ
howto.s5Body: ຮຽນໜ້າຈໍກ່ອນ. ເຊື່ອມ AI ຂອງທ່ານເປັນຂັ້ນຕອນຕໍ່ມາ.
